\documentclass{article}
\newcommand{\Gt}{(\Gamma_L+\Gamma_R)}
\begin{document}
Without dephasing the branching ratios sum to one,
\begin{equation}
\frac{\Gamma_L}{\Gt} + \frac{\Gamma_R}{\Gt} = 1 .
\label{eq:b1}
\end{equation}
\renewcommand{\Gt}{(\Gamma_L+\Gamma_R+\Gamma_\varphi)}
With a dephasing probe the total width includes $\Gamma_\varphi$,
\begin{equation}
\frac{\Gamma_L}{\Gt} + \frac{\Gamma_R}{\Gt} + \frac{\Gamma_\varphi}{\Gt} = 1 .
\label{eq:b2}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
